items.source: to be used in combination with FieldType.Dense_Vector
when this field is a {String}, a {Collection} or a {Map} that is empty this property controlls whether the empty value is sent to Elasticsearch.
items.translation: 当该字段为 {String}、{Collection} 或 {Map} 且为空时，此属性控制是否将空值发送到 Elasticsearch。

items.source:
Controls how Elasticsearch dynamically adds fields to the inner object within the document.
To be used in combination with FieldType.Object or FieldType.Nested
items.translation:
控制 Elasticsearch 如何动态地将字段添加到文档内部的对象中。
需与FieldType.Object或FieldType.Nested配合使用。

items.source: to be used in combination with FieldType.Object
overrides the field type in the mapping which otherwise will be taken from corresponding FieldType
items.translation: 覆盖映射中的字段类型，否则该类型将从对应的FieldType中获取。

items.source: to be used in combination with FieldType.Rank_Feature

marks this field to be excluded from the _source in Elasticsearch
(https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/7.15/mapping-source-field.html#include-exclude)
items.translation: 将此字段标记为在 Elasticsearch 的 `_source` 中排除（https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/7.15/mapping-source-field.html#include-exclude）

items.source: implemented as array to enable the empty default value
items.translation: 实现为数组以启用空默认值。

items.source: if true, the field will be stored in Elasticsearch even if it has a null value
items.translation: 如果为真，即使该字段值为 null，也会将其存储在 Elasticsearch 中。

items.translation: 用于在文档中存储该字段的名称。

items.source: The name to be used to store the field inside the document. If not set, the name of the annotated property is used.
items.translation: 用于在文档中存储字段的 名称。如果未设置，则使用已注解属性的名称。

items.source: NOte that null_value setting are not supported in Elasticsearch for all types.
items.translation: 请注意，并非所有类型的 Elasticsearch 都支持 null_value 设置。

items.source:
NOte that null_value setting are not supported in Elasticsearch for all types. For example setting a null_value on
a field with type text will throw an exception in the server when the mapping is written to Elasticsearch. Alas,
the Elasticsearch documentation does not specify on which types it is allowed on which it is not.
items.translation: 请注意，并非所有类型的 Elasticsearch 都支持设置 null_value。例如，在类型为 text 的字段上设置 null_value，当映射写入 Elasticsearch 时会在服务器端抛出异常。遗憾的是，Elasticsearch 文档并未明确规定哪些类型允许此设置，哪些不允许。
